spans.s: kṛmi (in sense of glow-worm, see kimi); Kṛmi, n. of a nāga king: Mvy 〔3248〕; Māy 〔246.33〕.
kṛmilika, m., a kind of cloth: Mvy 〔9173〕; acc. to Tib. and Chin. a red cloth made of calfʼs hair.
kṛmivarṇā, a kind of red cloth: Mvy 〔9174〕; Bhīk 〔22b.4〕; acc. to Chin. on Mvy something like red gauze.
Kṛmiśa or Kṛmiṣa, n. of a yakṣa: Divy 〔434.18 ff.〕
